## Summary

Refreshes `store-assets/base-metadata.json` from the redacted Published Partner Center submission exported by the **Store metadata** [workflow run {{RUN_ID}}](https://github.com/jerney-nexus/epikrise/actions/runs/{{RUN_ID}}).

`store-assets/base-metadata.json` is the source used by future Store metadata runs to sync listing data to Partner Center. Review the complete diff before merging. **Do not merge blindly:** merging replaces the base-branch file and can discard changes that exist only on that branch, including unreleased Store release notes.

## Review checklist

<!-- Please tick all applicable checkboxes. -->

- [ ] Confirm the linked workflow run used the intended Published submission.
- [ ] Review the entire `store-assets/base-metadata.json` diff, including every locale, listing text, image metadata, `Id`, `ApplicationPackages`, and `FriendlyName`.
- [ ] Confirm the diff contains no upload URLs, credentials, secrets, or patient data.
- [ ] Resolve any intended base-only changes, especially release notes, before merging.

## Related issue

None — this PR refreshes the Store metadata baseline from the Published submission.

## Validation

Generated by the **Store metadata** workflow. The workflow requires a Published submission, redacts upload URLs from its metadata export, parses the exported JSON, and rejects an export that still contains an upload URL before copying it into the PR branch.

## AI assistance

Opened automatically by the workflow; no AI-generated content.
